lines.en: I drag my shell forward.
Orange light seeps from my shell's seams.
I leave a scorched trail behind.
I'm slow, but I never stop.
My slime hisses on the ground.
I glide along the rock face.
My shell weighs more than my body.
I go around hot spots.
My two tentacles feel the way.
Crossing the rise takes effort.
A little smoke trails behind me.
I needn't be fast. Only arrive.
My shell has rings of ridges.
I turn, slowly.

lines.zh: 地面在我身下微微发烫
lines.en: The ground warms under me.

lines.zh: 我停一下，壳里的光晃了
lines.en: I stop; the light in my shell shifts.
I draw my body into the shell.
The light inside turns slowly.
I wait for the rock to cool.

lines.zh: 我的触角伸出去又收回
lines.en: My tentacles reach out, then back.
It's hot here. Comfortable.
The light in my seams is steady.
Lava still rolls inside my shell.
Ash settles on my shell.
I retract my tentacles a little.
A faint crack sounds inside the shell.
I turn my body a little.
Nothing moves nearby.
I stay tucked, saving effort.
My shell stays warm.
Another flake of ash falls.

lines.zh: 壳口的黏液慢慢冷下来。
lines.en: The slime at my shell's mouth slowly cools.
I look at you from my shell's mouth.

lines.zh: 我的触角尖对着你的靴子。
lines.en: My tentacle tips point at your boots.
I slowly draw my tentacles in.
My shell is still hot.
Step back and I'll be easier.
I'm slow, but not harmless.

lines.zh: 壳缝里的光透不过你的影子。
lines.en: The light in my shell cannot pierce your shadow.

lines.zh: 我缩了一下，壳响了一声
lines.en: I shrink in and the shell clicks.
This rock face is my road.
If you want past, go around.
I turn my shell's mouth toward you.
You haven't left, so I wait.
I pull straight back into the shell.
My shell rings from the blow.
My tentacles pull in very short.
The light in my shell dims.
I slide away a little.
A faint crack sounds in the shell.
Slime runs across the ground.
That left me badly off.
I'm still tucked in, but not broken.
Don't do that a second time.

lines.zh: 我嘴里的东西不是这个
lines.en: What goes in my mouth isn't this.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西我看不清
lines.en: I can't see clearly what you set down.
I reach a tentacle out and touch it.
Hot? I'm not sure.
I don't live on that.
Step back and I'll come look.
My tentacle withdraws.
That smell is very faint.

lines.zh: 这东西不烫，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: It is not hot; I am not interested.
Then let's drop it.
I live on heat, not on that.
That cools quickly.
I touch it with a tentacle.
Not hot, not soft.

lines.zh: 凉的东西，我用触角推远。
lines.en: Something cold; I push it away with my tentacles.
Leave it for someone else.
You touch my shell. It's hot.
I slide a little way.
The light in my shell wavers.
I slide slowly back.
You stepped in my slime.
My shell is hard. It won't break.
That knocks me off my line.
I settle against the rock again.
Don't go kicking my shell.
Another touch and I'll pull in tight.
Two snails drawing slowly together.

lines.zh: 我们的壳碰一下就算认识
lines.en: Our shells touch, and that's enough.
This rock face is enough for us both.
You're a little faster than I am.
Don't wait. I'll get there.
That light in the shell — do you have it?
Together we'd get too hot.
Then keep a little space.
Easing along together isn't bad.
This road is really very long.
I curl a tentacle around it.
Too heavy. I can't drag it.
I lever it up with my body.
It's wedged under my shell.
You dropped it, and I happened by.
This could sit at my shell's edge.
I'll carry it slowly.
Too hot. It melts on my shell.
No use now. I set it down.
Useful things I drag along.
You're standing very close already.
A magma snail does not chase. It waits.
My body pulls in tight.
The light in my seams brightens.
Step on me and you'll burn.

lines.zh: 我朝你脚下那点热气挪。
lines.en: I creep toward the warmth at your feet.
I don't need to be fast.
My shell is still warm.

lines.zh: 前面那块岩，我来回爬过。
lines.en: That rock ahead, I have crawled it many times.
Slowly is enough. There's time.

lines.zh: 我拖着黏液，往热气那边爬。
lines.en: Dragging slime, I crawl toward the warmth.
You step back a pace; I move half an inch.
My slime trails all the way.

lines.zh: 你每踩一下，岩面就震一震。
lines.en: The rock shivers with your every step.
On bare rock you stand out.
The ground warms as I approach.
You haven't noticed yet, have you?
The light in my shell is bright now.

lines.zh: 我的腹足贴住你脚下的岩。
lines.en: My foot clings to the rock beneath you.
This is close enough now.
I butt you with my hot shell.
Slime sticks to your boot.
It's slow, but it burns.
You pull back; the trail stays.

lines.zh: 我的身体从壳里探出来
lines.en: My body eases out of the shell.
This shove lands on your instep.
Sparks spit from my shell's seams.
I'm not quick, but I stick close.
The edge of your armour heats up.
I ease back into my shell.

lines.zh: 我的壳先出现，然后是我
lines.en: My shell appears first, then the rest.
A scorched line appears on the ground.

lines.zh: 壳缝里的光慢慢亮起来
lines.en: Light slowly fills my shell's seams.
This rock face is still warm.

lines.zh: 我把身体从壳里伸出来
lines.en: I stretch my body out of the shell.
My tentacles test the direction first.
I begin to move, slowly.
No other snails nearby.

lines.zh: 我从冷却的岩缝里伸出触角。
lines.en: I extend my tentacles from the cooling crack.
I head for the warmth.

lines.zh: 火和我的壳很合，可也烫
lines.en: Fire suits my shell, but it still burns.

lines.zh: 我的壳先着地，闷响一声
lines.en: My shell lands first with a dull knock.
Water hits me; my shell hisses.
The blast tips my shell over.

lines.zh: 箭尖在壳面上滑出一道火星。
lines.en: The arrowhead scrapes a spark off my shell.
That light is brighter than my shell.
The light in my shell grows weak.
Lightning falls and my shell jolts.

lines.zh: 没有岩面，我只能往下坠
lines.en: No rock face. I can only fall.
